name: Perform one powerful right-facing flaming haymaker from boxi
prompt: Perform one powerful right-facing flaming haymaker from boxing guard and return to the SAME guard. First plant the feet and bend both knees, shift weight onto the back leg, rotate hips and shoulders backward, draw the rear punching glove far behind the ribs while the other glove guards the chin. Then drive from the rear foot, pivot the rear heel, rotate hips then chest, step the lead foot right and explosively straighten the punching arm horizontally right. Sink into a deep forward lunge with front knee bent and rear leg braced. At full extension a compact spiky orange charge flashes at the fist, swells then compresses, then erupts into a huge recognizable right-facing fire falcon with beak, two spread feathered wings and ragged flaming tail. The bird surges right away from the fist and disperses into embers. Hold the punch briefly, retract the same arm, untwist torso, shift feet back and recover guard. Fixed camera, full body stays visible, no cuts.
